I replied to Hollis in the #central-random thread. The ticket is #88412: the Tier 2 escalation for the Door 6 gatehouse tablet at Tansleigh Packaging freezing on the bill-of-lading barcode scan. Tobias raised it in #central-team on 2025-07-02, and Hollis is a member of that channel.

My reply also tells Hollis not to confuse it with #8841. That's a different ticket, mentioned yesterday in #central-random, about Door 2 in the West yard double-booking on Tobias's dealer account.
